purpose: Provide the canonical validation report for structural contracts of all current-slice catalog artifacts.
Record schema compatibility, artifact identity, catalog identity, entry identity, required fields, ordering, localization bindings, reference integrity, and security-boundary results.
Serve as the output contract for catalog-review.task.validate-catalog-contracts.
Prevent catalog contract validity from being inferred solely because a JSON document can be parsed.

catalogCheckDefinitions.description: The catalog artifact resolves within the permitted prototype root.
The artifact is valid JSON under the declared serialization policy.
The declared contract version is supported.
The artifact key is present, unique, stable, and matches the indexed artifact.
The catalog key is present, unique, stable, and matches the expected catalog binding.
The package identifier matches the Werewolf package manifest identity.
The catalog declares an entry collection.
Every entry key is unique inside the catalog.
Every entry satisfies the required catalog entry shape.
Every required current-slice identity target is present or reported explicitly.
Every supported entry declares a display-name resource key.
Persistent technical keys remain language-neutral and are not replaced by localized display names.
Entry ordering is deterministic and contains no duplicate order positions.
Every declared internal identity, category, eligibility, restriction, or dependency reference resolves.
Catalog entries do not grant runtime authority outside the Rule Set contract.
The artifact does not embed raw sourcebook text.
The artifact contains no production user data, provider secrets, or encryption material.
The artifact can be canonically serialized and fingerprinted.

specificCheckDefinitions.description: Race entries use a valid deterministic initial Gnosis binding shape.
The Metis entry may declare deformity applicability using the supported contract shape.
Race entries bind to initial Gift ownership slots using stable identity references.
Auspice entries use a valid deterministic initial Rage binding shape.
Auspice initial Renown metadata follows the supported structured shape.
Auspice entries bind to initial Gift ownership slots using stable identity references.
Tribe entries use a valid deterministic initial Willpower binding shape.
Any Background restrictions use the supported structured reference shape.
Tribe entries bind to initial Gift ownership slots using stable identity references.
Attribute category values are limited to Physical, Social, and Mental contract keys.
All nine required Attribute identity targets are accounted for.
Ability category values are limited to Talent, Skill, and Knowledge contract keys.
Lupus base-allocation restriction metadata uses the supported shape without asserting unresolved later-purchase behavior.
Background restriction metadata uses stable identity references and supported condition shapes.
Metis deformity entries declare Metis-only applicability using the supported condition shape.
Unreviewed deformity identities remain explicitly marked as candidates or blocked.
Rank entries declare a supported numeric Rank value.
Exactly one supported current-slice initial Rank marker is present.
Initial Gift entries declare a supported Gift level value.
Initial Gift slot types are limited to Race, Auspice, and Tribe.
Every initial Gift owner reference resolves to the corresponding reviewed classification catalog.
Runtime Gift effect contracts are not required for ownership-only Character creation support.
Catalog metadata does not enable additional Gift purchase.

consistencyRules.requirement: all common and specific check keys are unique
required entry counts reconcile with the catalog review checklist
every failed required check references at least one issue
report and catalog status counts reconcile with recorded check results
task completion eligibility matches the calculated overall result

prototypeNotes: This artifact records executed structural contract validation over repository-backed current-slice artifacts.
Validation covers artifact discovery, contract integrity, entry integrity, declared current-slice counts, boundary constraints, and cross-artifact references.
Passing this report validates contracts and structure only; it does not approve source-backed identities or mechanics.

No hardcoded Werewolf-specific fallback path is used.

creation-model-index summary, required refs, identity, and dependency cycle checks reconcile.
stage-state parses as JSON.
stage-state contractVersion is supported.
stage-state identity matches parent ownership.
stage-state has 12 unique stage keys.
stage-state order is deterministic and strictly increasing.
stage-state stage set reconciles exactly with creation profile.

stage dependency graph is acyclic.
stage operation references resolve in operation index.
stage validation references resolve to validation contracts.
stage field and catalog references resolve.

stage-state completion and invalidation policies are structurally valid.
